verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform. Sandbox API keys let you call the APIs immediately with no UI, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published, and sandbox test cases support scripted, repeatable verification flows, so headless programmatic operation is inherent to the product. However, nothing documents CI-oriented use specifically. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI integration guidance, documented automated-testing workflows in pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
